name: KumarRobotics/jps3d
description: A C++ implementation of Jump Point Search for both 2D and 3D grid maps, optimizing A* by skipping intermediate nodes for faster optimal pathfinding in uniform-cost grids.
score_rationale: 464 stars, BSD-3-Clause, solid JPS implementation useful for robotics and game AI, though last active in 2021.
summary: C++ Jump Point Search for optimized 2D/3D grid pathfinding
